Taxes and fees at Amarillo hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($16 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 14% at Everhome Suites Amarillo West - Medical Center to 16% at Drury Inn & Suites Amarillo. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
